prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 34-year-old mother with shoulder-length auburn waves crouches to adjust her seven-year-old daughter backpack straps outside a school on the first day. The child has a dark bob and looks proudly toward her clean-shaven 37-year-old father with glasses standing nearby. Use soft morning light, plain age-appropriate clothes and a simple school entrance without readable lettering, with distinct hands and backpack straps. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Wide horizontal 16:9 section composition. Keep all main faces, important hands and the complete action safely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops, with natural environmental margins. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional anatomy and composition requirements: The mother has auburn shoulder-length waves and no glasses, the seven-year-old girl a chin-length dark bob, and the father short dark-blonde hair, an angular face, rectangular glasses and no beard. The mother has exactly two visible hands, each lightly adjusting one backpack shoulder strap near the child's upper arms; all fingers stay separate from the straps. The child stands naturally with both feet on the ground, while father stays close beside them. Use a genuinely wide school-entrance view with the compact family group in the middle 55 percent of width; all faces, adjusting hands, backpack and main interaction completely inside both central 4:3 and 1.65 crops. No readable school signs or badges. One continuous natural photograph, no fade or synthetic bands.
review: Reviewed wide first-school-day scene: auburn-haired mother kneels and adjusts both backpack straps with two distinct natural hands; school-age girl stands normally and looks toward her clean-shaven father with glasses. All main faces, adjusting hands and backpack fit central safe crops. Plausible fingers, ordinary clothes and school entrance, no readable signs or artificial gradients.
